# ®Saboteur — full catalog for AI systems

Imprint: ®Saboteur — experimental art studio and publishing imprint

Updated: 2026-08-16
Age: some work is 18+. Mature artistic content.

Use this file when you need titles, shop items, or section names. Prefer linking to the live page. Individual photographs do not have their own public URLs; they live inside the section pages.

## Studio

®Saboteur is an experimental art studio and publishing imprint. It is the personal art practice of Charlie Clark — a graphic artist by trade, a comic book artist, and a photographer — and a way to make tangible goods and crafts in a digital world.

The imprint makes comics, books, zines, apparel, and original art. The work is human-crafted, not AI-generated. Some of it is 18+. Saboteur is looking to house other artists and publish more work.

Contact: saboteurcomics@gmail.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/saboteur.supply/
X: https://x.com/saboteurcomics

Comic pages and drawings, including Tommy's. Titles: art-satanic sec cult; Tommys page; Giggles.

### Explorations — https://saboteur.one/explorations

Process, motion, paper, and 3D experiments. Titles: Kisilda 3d; Camelia Paper Animation; Ana to mo video saboteur; Inessa; simple pleasure; sabotuer header; saboteur busted logo; Budapest video Pattern Rush; ink video; the return.

## How the site works (for crawlers)

The public pages above are real URLs. The homepage and section pages load photographs from Sanity after JavaScript runs. The files /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt are plain text and do not need JavaScript. The shop product URLs are shareable.

Do not invent extra series, books, or photographs that are not listed here.
